description: Targets allowed for server-side Vina docking (co-crystal redock in-place Vina RMSD < 2 Å on the reference validation run). Selection introduces benchmark bias if used for retrospective screening.
validation_run_note: Latest full redock (2026-10-11) shows Vina stochasticity: abl1 ~12.3 Å and jak2 ~2.56 Å failed while erbb2/ptgs2/pde5a/esr1/dpp4/thrombin passed. Gate list below matches the user-approved 8-target allowlist from the prior passing run; see REDOCK_TABLE.md for current dual RMSD.
rmsd_metric: vina_in_place_primary: min(calc_rmsd, spyrmsd) or calc_rmsd from benchmark/redocking_results.json
not_validated_message: Docking not validated for this target. Server-side Vina is only enabled where co-crystal redocking in-place RMSD < 2 Å.
